# Tag option types and values are documented at:
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/information-schema-table-options
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/tags#list_tags_attached_to_a_dataset
# Synthetic tag definitions use the emulator's documented IAM exception.
# These single-tag cases do not assume an order for multiple tags.

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS scalars_tags OPTIONS (tags = [('123456789012/env', 'test')]);
ALTER SCHEMA scalars_tags SET OPTIONS (tags = [('123456789012/env', 'Production')]);
SELECT CONCAT(option_type, ' ', option_value) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA_OPTIONS WHERE schema_name = 'scalars_tags' AND option_name = 'tags'
=> "ARRAY<STRUCT<STRING, STRING>> [STRUCT(\"123456789012/env\", \"Production\")]"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars.tags_altered (x INT64) OPTIONS (tags = [('123456789012/old', 'test')]);
ALTER TABLE scalars.tags_altered SET OPTIONS (tags = [('123456789012/env', 'Production')]);
ALTER TABLE scalars.tags_altered SET OPTIONS (description = 'retains tags');
SELECT CONCAT(option_type, ' ', option_value) FROM scalars.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_OPTIONS WHERE table_name = 'tags_altered' AND option_name = 'tags'
=> "ARRAY<STRUCT<STRING, STRING>> [STRUCT(\"123456789012/env\", \"Production\")]"

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW scalars.tags_view OPTIONS (tags = [('123456789012/env', 'test')]) AS SELECT 1 AS x;
SELECT option_value FROM scalars.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_OPTIONS WHERE table_name = 'tags_view' AND option_name = 'tags'
=> "[STRUCT(\"123456789012/env\", \"test\")]"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars.tags_mv_source (x INT64);
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW scalars.tags_mv OPTIONS (tags = [('123456789012/env', 'test')]) AS SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM scalars.tags_mv_source;
SELECT option_value FROM scalars.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_OPTIONS WHERE table_name = 'tags_mv' AND option_name = 'tags'
=> "[STRUCT(\"123456789012/env\", \"test\")]"

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars.tags_snapshot_source (x INT64);
CREATE SNAPSHOT TABLE scalars.tags_snapshot CLONE scalars.tags_snapshot_source OPTIONS (tags = [('123456789012/env', 'test')]);
SELECT option_value FROM scalars.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_OPTIONS WHERE table_name = 'tags_snapshot' AND option_name = 'tags'
=> "[STRUCT(\"123456789012/env\", \"test\")]"

# Documented tag detachment removes the matching key/value pair and keeps other tags.
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/tags#detach_tags_from_a_table
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE scalars.tags_removed (x INT64) OPTIONS (tags = [('123456789012/env', 'test'), ('123456789012/team', 'sales')]);
ALTER TABLE scalars.tags_removed SET OPTIONS (tags -= [('123456789012/env', 'test')]);
SELECT option_value FROM scalars.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_OPTIONS WHERE table_name = 'tags_removed' AND option_name = 'tags'
=> "[STRUCT(\"123456789012/team\", \"sales\")]"
